description: The Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset brings four major measures of food insecurity onto one monthly, sub-national grid: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification and Cadre Harmonisé phases, FEWS NET IPC-compatible phases, and the World Food Programme's Food Consumption Score and reduced Coping Strategy Index. Each row gives the month, the administrative unit on GADM geometry and the value from each source available. The producer is the European Commission Joint Research Centre (Melissande Machefer, Felix Rembold and colleagues) with Action Against Hunger, described in Scientific Data in 2025. Coverage is the countries monitored by these systems, mostly in Africa, Asia and Latin America, at first or second administrative level, going back as far as each source allows. Data and code are on Zenodo as CSV with GeoPackage and shapefile geometries, free under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: the sources differ in method and timing, coverage is patchy where no assessment took place, and the Zenodo release read today is version 1.1.1 from March 2025 although the paper describes monthly updates. Simulation uses: outcome data for validating models of food supply disruption, training forecasting models for anticipatory humanitarian action, and mapping where supply shocks meet vulnerable populations. Related records: FEWS NET Data Explorer (data-fews-net-data-explorer) and the WFP food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices).
